scope: 82 new focuses,32 national spirits,12 state modifiers,4 compact decisions and1 category; existing378 focus artwork preserved
method: Existing source-component composition, background-only recoloring and two approved crops from inherited local artwork; no AI generation or downloads.

permission.basis: Selected Ultimate HOI4 GFX files: CREDITS states contributor consent and free use; no license inferred for other artwork from contributing mods.
permission.attribution: Globvs / Ultimate HOI4 GFX contributors; individual author mapping unknown
permission.continuation: kpopmodder: component selection, native-size composition, background recoloring, cropped inherited symbols and integration

background_rule: A > 0, R-G > 6, R-B > 3, B-G >= -4; pow(luminance/60,0.9), shade reference RGB, retain original alpha; foreground and metallic borders unfiltered

shared_runtime_assets.modifications: Existing project copy reused unchanged; separate from public pack permission

inherited_crops.attribution: Inherited Hearts of Korea asset; individual original artist unknown
inherited_crops.reuse_basis: Authorized continuation of original project; user approved selected local crop
inherited_crops.changes: Transparent upper crown crop; original colors retained; no dragon-seal claim

inherited_crops.attribution: Inherited Hearts of Korea flag asset; individual original artist unknown
inherited_crops.reuse_basis: Authorized continuation of original project; user approved selected local crop
inherited_crops.changes: Decode uncompressed BGRA TGA, crop central23x23 and circular alpha clip; original Taegeuk colors; not a three-legged crow
